audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: 'level chart contradicts data: Zaahen wins 55.36% but the chart gives Riven 4/7 stages vs 0'. Both item stages read Riven with 5/10 ratings.
audit.why: Riven genuinely owns levels 2 through 6 — Broken Wings charges, an 11s Ki Burst stun and the Valor shield are a real burst window a bruiser cannot answer at those levels. What the chart got wrong is the item stages: Riven's damage is one combo, Zaahen's is sustained, and he heals from his Q, heals from his R and revives at filled Determination. The mirror audit already flipped first item and 2+ items to Zaahen.
audit.corrected: Rows 5 and 6 flipped to Zaahen as matched full/content pairs, with ratings raised from 5/10 to 6/10 and 7/10 to mirror the 4/10 and 3/10 the Riven side took. whys[5] and whys[6] restated on his sustain rather than her burst. Rows 0-4 unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and spikes[3] handed both item windows to Riven with 'her combo can outright kill you' and 'her mobility and burst let her pick the terms'.
audit.why: Riven's spike is front-loaded and finite — three Broken Wings casts on a 13s cooldown and one Wind Slash. Zaahen's item stages add sustain that outlasts exactly that: the Q double slash heals, the R heals for a portion of the damage dealt, and filled Determination gives bonus Attack Damage plus a revive. Every one of those is in Riot's own text and none of them appeared on the page.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] and spikes[3] rewritten as Zaahen windows built on the heals and the revive; 'late' rewritten to match and to attribute the 55% correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Q Darkin Glaive', 'E Golden Onslaught' and 'R Final Retribution' were used as Zaahen's ability names. Ki Burst's 11s cooldown and 260 range, Broken Wings' 13s, and Blade of the Exile's 120s were all absent, and the W pull's use against her combo was never stated.
audit.why: Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1 at only 260 range — she must be on top of you, and without the stun the chain does not connect, which is why the whole page says 'dodge her stun'. Riot's Blade of the Exile text gives Attack Damage and RANGE plus one Wind Slash — it is not an execute. Zaahen's 850-range W pull is the one tool that interrupts her positioning during Broken Wings, and both sides carrying displacement means whoever lands it first owns the trade.
audit.corrected: Fabricated names removed; Ki Burst 11s / 260 range, Broken Wings 13s and Blade of the Exile 120s written into spikes[0], spikes[1], mid, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t; the W pull named as the answer to her combo.

edits.before: Her first-item spike lets Riven's combo threaten a full kill.
edits.after: At first item your Q heal and R sustain outlast her burst combo.

edits.before: Late, her mobility and burst keep dictating side-lane duels against you.
edits.after: Late, your sustain and Determination revive outlast her burst duels.

edits.before: Riven's level 3 with all three Broken Wings (Q) charges, Ki Burst (W) stun and Valor (E) shield is a brutal burst window — she animation-cancels a full combo before your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught can retaliate, so never trade into a fresh W.
edits.after: Riven's level 3 with all three Broken Wings (Q) charges, the Ki Burst (W) stun on 11s and the Valor (E) shield is a brutal burst window — she animation-cancels a full combo before your Q and E can answer, so never trade into a fresh W.

edits.before: Your R Final Retribution gives you a real answer at 6, but Riven's own ult Blade of the Exile plus Wind Slash execute lets her all-in through it, so the fight stays in her favour unless you land E to blunt her engage.
edits.after: Your R answers at 6 and heals you for part of the damage it deals, but Blade of the Exile extends her range and adds one Wind Slash, so she can commit through it. Land your W pull — it drags her out of the Broken Wings chain.

edits.before: Riven spikes hardest on her first item — with a bruiser component her empowered Q/W burst can outright kill you in one combo, and her E shield lets her dive under tower, so play safe and farm the wave.
edits.after: This is where it turns: her burst is three Broken Wings casts on a 13s cooldown and then nothing, while your Q heals you and your R heals off the damage it deals. Survive the opener and the extended fight is yours.

edits.before: Even late Riven's mobility and burst let her pick the terms of a side-lane duel; your job is to survive her spikes with sustain and drag the game to teamfights where your R and tankiness matter more than her single-target combo.
edits.after: Late, Riven still picks the terms of the opening, but she cannot finish you: your Q heals, your R heals for a portion of the damage dealt, and filled Determination gives bonus Attack Damage and a revive. Outlast the opener, then walk her down.

edits.before: Riven owns levels 3 through 6: her Broken Wings (Q) plus Ki Burst (W) stun burst you before your Q Darkin Glaive answers, and even your R Final Retribution at 6 can be dived through by her Blade of the Exile all-in.
edits.after: Riven owns levels 3 through 6: Broken Wings plus the Ki Burst stun burst you before your Q answers, and even your R at 6 can be committed through by Blade of the Exile. Her W is 11s at rank 1 — that gap is your trade window.

edits.before: This stays hard into items — her first-item combo can one-shot and her E/R mobility dictates duels, so survive with sustain, avoid her W stun, and lean on your Juggernaut teamfight value instead of solo trades.
edits.after: Into items this swings to you — her burst is one combo while yours is sustained: the Q heals, the R heals off the damage it deals, and filled Determination revives you. Deny the W stun opener and the 55% is yours.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ki Burst (W): matchup-defining — 11s at rank 1 at only 260 range; without the stun her combo falls apart. - Broken Wings (Q): 13s for all three casts. - Blade of the Exile (R): 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her engage CC, 11s at rank 1 — commit only once it is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile adds range and one Wind Slash — respect both.

edits.before: Track Riven's Ki Burst (Stun): Her engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — Combo + R her.
edits.after: Ki Burst is an 11s stun at just 260 range; without it her whole combo falls apart.
